_note: Craft lens, round 2, carousel no. 71, returned by carousel-scorer and saved in shape.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frame 6 the best frame, 4 and 2 work. The officer's shell vest and mannequin pose on 5 and 6, tires buried on 5, frame 7 a thin column in a void with jagged top and weak band change, frame 8's flat folders with a label outside the safe zone crossed by the mic, frame 9's notch, seam, placard notice and mid-tone wall, frame 1's pod a sixth of the frame over a pale flank.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One key, one register, one palette, the camera move and the bluebonnet motif both work. The measured scale changes meaning between 6 and 7; the interiors sit slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. The memo counts rest on FOX 4 and Dallas Express. Hygiene: c59 missing from the first comment, retrieval stamps said November 7th against a November 8th re-source, a stale rejected entry, stale dossier lines.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Names the body, the vendor, the districts, the money and West's withdrawn cut. No date for the next appropriation or briefing; the close ends general.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The process reads in order, 2 pays at once, the turn at 6 lands. 3 and 5 overlap and the cover headline is descriptive.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain and specific with a strong caption opener; some deks flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A fresh setting and subject after nos. 68 to 70; the measured counter stack under staged lastLight is familiar.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A thin column in the right fifth with an empty left two thirds, a jagged top, a weak band change, and a scale that means something different from frame 6.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Macro the officer's 57-card sheaf edge-on at 0.2 mm with the divider proud after card 39, the column soft behind.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Three flat beige rectangles; the '10 days' notice' label outside the safe zone with the mic through it.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model folder thickness and a paper edge, drop the camera so they fill the bottom third, move the label inside x 80 to 1000 clear of the stem.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Shell vest, mannequin pose, tires lost under the brush.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Conform the vest or swap it, angle him to the pile, pull the brush back so both tires show.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Placard notice, mannequin resident, riser notch, brick seam, mid-tone wall.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Letter-size notice in both hands, close the notch and seam, narrow the key onto the figure.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The pod a sixth of the frame over a pale flank with no street.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the eye so the pod fills a third against the dark street, rake the key only across the top rail.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The sheaf faces the camera so its same-scale thickness does not read; shell vest.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rotate the clipboard edge-on beside the column's bundle edges.
